Loose Gemstones
Gem Type(s): Amethyst, Citrine, Emerald, Blue Spinel, Peridot, Garnet
Please note, the appraisal was donated with the gemstones. Carat weight could vary. All gemstones have been identified and tested in-house by a Certified Gemologist. You are bidding with this in mind.
Used. All pre-owned Gemstones, Pearls, Marcasite, Amber, and/or Diamonds may show signs of wear, damage, debris, nicks, chips, abrasion, cloudiness, scratches, blemishes, inclusions, and/or scuff marks due to previous wear and age.
Jadeite, Nephrite, Opal, and Cabochon Stones may contain below surface crazing, abrasions, or other natural abnormalities.
Amber could have inorganic inclusions and irregular growth patterns including but not limited to: scratches, irregular structure, breaks, splits, feathering, below surface bubbles, and more.
If applicable, Gemstones weighed with 8068-series Professional Digital Jewelry Scale.
If Gemstones, Pearls, Amber, Marcasite or Diamonds are present, they have been visually inspected and/or tested using a Presidium Gem Tester. This tester does not differentiate between natural and lab created/synthetic gemstones.
If Diamonds are present, Diamond(s) are tested with GEMORO PRO-D 3+. See photos for positive Diamond test.
“Carat” in titles could have been rounded up or down to the nearest decimal.
Gems may have possible treatments and enhancements.
Lighting conditions could affect coloring of gemstones.
Synthetic or Natural Opals could be exposed to extreme temperature changes during shipping.
Loose lots may include Natural, Synthetic Man-Made Gemstones, Glass, and Plastic.
Sizes are approximate, yet, not all gemstones have been measured.
Includes a variety of gemstone cuts ranging from Cabochon, Fancy, and Traditional cuts.
Includes some that have not been properly cut.
TW could include packaging and storage bags unless otherwise stated.
Due to the size of loose gemstone lots we do not supply an inventory. Therefore, there will be no returns or refunds accepted on this auction. You are bidding with this in mind.
All photos are considered part of the condition description. Please review them carefully for details on markings, wear, and overall condition. Photography props such as mannequins, hangers, busts, pennies, stands, watch pillows, trays, crystal displays and more are not included in the auction unless otherwise stated.
This lot is sold AS IS with NO RETURNS OR REFUNDS.
We will not accept returns for items that have undergone acid testing. Our XRF readings provide a more accurate measure of metal content.
You are bidding with every factor, statement, and photograph in mind.
